title: Chocolate Swirl Cannabis Banana Bread Recipe
metaDescription: A moist chocolate-swirl cannabis banana bread where only part of the butter is cannabutter, with per-slice dose math and loaf or mini-loaf options.
excerpt: Swap only part of the butter for cannabutter, marble in melted chocolate and cut even slices: a gift-worthy loaf where every piece carries an estimated dose.
keyTakeaways: Choose a dose per slice first, then replace only that share of the butter with cannabutter.
A 9x5 loaf cuts into 10 even slices; four mini loaves give you 12 smaller ones for sharing.
Stir a cup of batter into melted chocolate, alternate scoops in the pan and swirl just two or three times.
Label every loaf with the dose per slice, and give it only to adults 21+ who know it's infused.
body:
This chocolate-swirl cannabis banana bread is a moist, marbled infused quick bread built on one simple idea: only part of the butter is cannabutter. You choose the dose per slice, swap in exactly that much infused butter and cut even slices. Bake one big loaf for a crowd, or four mini loaves to share.

## How to dose cannabis banana bread

1. Count your slices: a 9x5 loaf cuts neatly into 10, and four mini loaves into 3 each.
2. Multiply your target mg per slice by the number of slices. That's the THC the batch needs.
3. Divide by your cannabutter's estimated mg per tablespoon. That's how much [cannabutter](/blog/canna-butter-recipe/) to use; plain butter makes up the rest of the 1/2 cup.

Melt the two butters together and whisk them into the wet ingredients first, so every slice gets its share. The same partial-swap math works for [pot brownies](/blog/pot-brownies-recipe/) and [cannabis cookies](/blog/cannabis-cookie-recipe/), and our [THC dosage guide](/blog/thc-dosage-guide/) helps you choose a starting amount.

## Ingredients for cannabutter banana bread

Very ripe, well-spotted bananas, flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, buttermilk, eggs, vanilla, the butter blend and a cup of chocolate chips melted for the swirl. Buttermilk keeps the crumb tender; 1/2 cup of milk with 1 1/2 teaspoons of lemon juice stands in if you're out. Making cannabutter from scratch? Browse your nearest High Society store's [menu](/shop/) for flower and order ahead for curbside pickup.

## Mixing and baking

Mash the bananas well, whisk in the wet ingredients and fold everything into the dry just until no flour shows, then marble in the chocolate batter. A full loaf bakes about an hour at 350 °F, and mini loaves take roughly half that. Let the bread cool completely, or the slices crumble and come out uneven.

## Storage and labeling

Wrapped tightly, the bread keeps at room temperature for a few days, or you can freeze it by the slice. Label every loaf and freezer bag 'contains THC' with the dose per slice and the date, and keep it somewhere children and pets can't reach. If someone eats a slice by accident, call Poison Control at 1-800-222-1222.

## Gifting it the right way

Banana bread is a classic gift, and this one comes with conditions. Give it only to adults 21 and older who know it's infused, with the dose written on the label. Michigan law lets adults give cannabis, within legal limits, to another adult 21+ when nothing is received in return and the gift isn't advertised. So these loaves are for sharing, never for selling; our [Michigan cannabis law guide](/cannabis-laws-by-state/michigan/) has the limits. More gift-worthy bakes are in our [holiday infused recipes](/blog/holiday-cannabis-infused-recipes/).

Please consume responsibly.

faq.q: How much cannabutter should go in banana bread?
faq.a: Only as much as your dose calls for. Multiply your target mg per slice by the number of slices, then divide by your cannabutter's estimated mg per tablespoon. Use that much cannabutter and plain butter for the rest. For a first batch, aim low: Health Canada suggests new consumers start at 2.5 mg of THC or less.

faq.q: How do I get the swirl?
faq.a: Stir about a cup of finished batter into melted, slightly cooled chocolate. Layer alternating spoonfuls of plain and chocolate batter in the pan, then run a butter knife through it in two or three slow S-shapes. Stop there. Extra swirling blends the two batters into one brown loaf.

faq.q: Can I freeze infused banana bread?
faq.a: Yes, and freezing by the slice makes portioning easy. Wrap each cooled slice, bag them together and label the bag with the dose per slice and the date. Use them within 3 to 4 months. Thaw a slice at room temperature for about an hour, or warm it briefly in a low oven.

recipe.yield: 1 loaf (10 slices) or 4 mini loaves (12 slices)
ingredients: 1/2 cup (8 tablespoons) butter in total: your measured cannabutter plus plain butter, melted together (see the dosing note)
steps: Set the oven to 350 °F. Grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan, or four mini loaf pans, and line with parchment.
Whisk the flour, baking soda and salt together in a medium bowl.
In a large bowl, whisk the melted butter blend and sugar until smooth, then whisk in the bananas, buttermilk, eggs and vanilla.
Tip the dry ingredients into the wet and fold with a spatula just until no dry flour is visible.
Melt the chocolate chips in 20-second microwave bursts, stirring between each, and cool for 3 minutes. Stir 1 cup of the batter into the chocolate.
Spoon plain and chocolate batter into the pan in alternating dollops, then swirl with a knife two or three times.
Bake 55 to 65 minutes for a loaf, or 30 to 35 for minis, until a skewer comes out clean. Cool 10 minutes in the pan, then completely on a rack, before cutting even slices.
recipe.dosingNote: **Per-slice estimate:** target mg per slice × slices = THC for the batch, and that total ÷ your cannabutter's mg per tablespoon = tablespoons of cannabutter. Example: 5 mg × 10 slices = 50 mg. With cannabutter at about 25 mg per tablespoon, use 2 tablespoons of it plus 6 tablespoons of plain butter. A homemade batch's real strength depends on your flower's potency and on decarboxylation and infusion losses, so the result is an estimate. Start with one slice, wait at least 2 hours before more, label every loaf, and keep it away from children and pets.

review.notes: Independent fact-check, 2026-10-24. Baking figures checked against a UNH Extension handout (text pulled from its PDF), King Arthur and USDA-based flour weights and a buttermilk-substitute reference; storage and dosing lines against Illinois Extension, the CDC FAQ and Health Canada. The gifting sentence matched law-facts mi-au-gifting except for the missing cap; rather than state an ounce figure for a baked good, the text now says 'within legal limits' and links the Michigan law page. High Society: one mention (menu for flower, curbside), in hs-facts. Writer's notes: Gift only to informed adults 21+ with the dose on the label (brief mustAvoid). Example mg only. Pot brownies and cookie links make no claim about those recipes beyond the math applying. High Society mentioned once (menu for flower, curbside pickup).
